UNDERSTANDING DECIMALS
====

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN
----
• Say what understanding decimals means in plain words.
• Give one clear example linked to Decimals.

INTRODUCTION
----
Understanding Decimals. Get clear on decimals before moving on. How would you explain decimals to a classmate in one minute? Use this anchor: explain decimals with correct terms and a clear worked example. Check every example on this page against that anchor.

MAIN NOTES
----
• Decimals extend place value to the right of the point: tenths, hundredths, thousandths.
• 0.25 means 25 hundredths, which equals 1/4.
• Percent means “per hundred”: 25% = 25/100 = 0.25.
• Line up the decimal points when adding or subtracting.
• Money in Kenya (Ksh and cents) is everyday decimal practice.

WORKED EXAMPLE
----
Worked example on Decimals:
Find 10% of 250.

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Percentage amount = (percent / 100) × whole
2. Substitute values: Amount = (10/100) × 250
3. Amount = 0.1 × 250
4. Amount = 25
Final Answer: 25
